text: Warehouse questions are one of the most heavily-tested single topics on DP-700. This lesson works through scenarios at exam difficulty, focused specifically on Fabric Warehouse.

A BI tool connecting over a standard SQL connection string, issuing T-SQL joins and window functions with strict schema needs, is a Warehouse — the full T-SQL surface, not a Lakehouse's read-only subset.

A Warehouse supports full multi-table transactions with rollback. A Lakehouse gets its guarantees from Delta Lake's per-table ACID transactions instead — and only a Warehouse's SQL endpoint supports writes.
That read/write asymmetry between Warehouse and Lakehouse SQL endpoints is one of the most exam-tested facts in this domain. Next up: practice questions on Eventstreams and KQL.
